name: AI Slop Stopper
job: Checks any text for AI tells; every Monday hunts new AI-slop patterns (proposals need approval)
cadence: Any time from the Check text box on Review; Mondays, a hunt for new AI-slop patterns
card_only: Paste text into the Check text box on the Review page
ask_note: Paste text into the Check text box on the Review page. He answers right away, with no model and nothing stored.

does: Checks any text for AI tells: flags each one with its rule from IHG's AI-tell list and gives a clean rewrite that only removes the tells
Every Monday, hunts for new kinds of AI slop going around and proposes each one as a card
Says plainly when a paragraph already reads like a person wrote it

traits.cant: Add a new tell to the list on his own
traits.instead: Proposes it as a card; Katherine approves or rejects it, and a rejected tell is never proposed again

traits.cant: Change the facts, the meaning or anything in quotes
traits.instead: Only removes the tells, and lists what still needs a person

traits.cant: Publish, send or store what you paste
traits.instead: Checks it on the spot and hands the result back to you
